name: Health Coverage
sourceRefs: Stedi (stedi.com/edi/x12-005010/segment/HD) — the actual health-coverage/plan-enrollment fact at 834's own 2300 loop. HD01 (maintenanceTypeCode, same code set INS03 already uses — "021"=Change, "024"=Addition, "030"=Cancellation/Termination) is the real per-PLAN maintenance action (distinct from INS03's own per-MEMBER action); HD03 (insuranceLineCode, e.g. "HLT"=Health, "DEN"=Dental, "VIS"=Vision) + HD04 (plan coverage description, the plan/product name or code) are the core plan-identity fields this schema's own Coverage FHIR mapping reads.
